values.note: Every site has water and 50-amp electric; only 3 of the 70 (sites 01, 21 and 43, the 'Interior - Sewer' rate) also have sewer.

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232655 ('70 public use camp sites with full water and electric hookups (30 and 50 amp)') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232655 (all 70 sites Electricity Hookup 50 / Water Hookup Yes; Sewer Hookup Y on 01, 21, 43, all reservable), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 70 public sites (plus 2 park-attendant sites), 13 pull-through; most take vehicles up to 40 ft, a few 20-30 ft. One wheeled camping unit per site, parked on the impact pad; up to 3 registered vehicles.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232655 ('2 park attendant campsites, 70 public use camp sites'; notices on one wheeled unit and 3 vehicles) + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232655 (Max Vehicle Length 20-50, 37 sites at 40; 13 Pull-through), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232655 ('5 comfort stations (3 with showers), 1 dump station'; amenities Flush Toilets, Showers) + Corps Hartwell camping page (Drinking Water, Showerhouse, Dump Station), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Run by the Corps' Hartwell Project with resident park attendants. Reservable on recreation.gov up to the day of arrival; one site (61) is not reservable online. 14 nights in any 30 days. Gate locked 10 pm-7 am, so check in before 10 pm; check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232655 (rules: maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 0 days, minConsecutiveStay 1; notices on the gate and check-in/out) + campsite catalog (site 61 reservable: false), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 Peak Season (May 1-Oct 30): $38 a night for a standard water/electric site, $42 for the three sewer sites. The rate table also carries two unnamed site rates at $44 and $76.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232655/rates (2026 Peak Season: 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' 38, 'INTERIOR - SEWER' 42, 'STANDARD ELECTRIC-74066' 44, 'STANDARD ELECTRIC-74077' 76), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $38-42 (2026), 50-amp + water at all 70 sites (sewer at only 3, now noted), reservable on recreation.gov. Added the Corps' May 1-Oct 31 season, 70 sites to 50 ft with 13 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/water/dump, 14-night limit. Not stated: booking window, senior-pass acceptance.
flags: Entry has no phone. recreation.gov and the Corps camping page give 1-888-893-0678 (Hartwell Project Office).
